request.style: English, female voice, solo with light choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, uplifting and heroic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
David at Ziklag in the wild
Saul the king kept him confined
Men with bows and slings came near
From Benjamin they joined the field
Ahiezer and Joash lead
Shemaah's sons from Gibeon
Armed with shield and spear in hand
Facing the battle ground

[Chorus]
Their faces like the faces of lions
Swift as gazelles on the mountains
Mighty warriors in the fight
With shields and spears held tight
The Gadite men so brave
Crossed the Jordan in the wave

[Verse]
Ezer the chief Obadiah two
Eliab third in the crew
Mishmannah four Jeremiah five
Attai six with Eliel's drive
Johanan eight and Elzabad ninth
Jeremiah tenth in the depth
Machbannai the eleventh man
Strongest of the Gadite clan
The least for a hundred men
The greatest for a thousand then

[Chorus]
Their faces like the faces of lions
Swift as gazelles on the mountains
Mighty warriors in the fight
With shields and spears held tight
The Gadite men so brave
Crossed the Jordan in the wave

[Bridge]
First month the river overflowed
Driving out the valley road
They crossed the Jordan stream
To help David with his dream
Peace to you son of Jesse
We are with you in distress

[Chorus]
Their faces like the faces of lions
Swift as gazelles on the mountains
Mighty warriors in the fight
With shields and spears held tight
The Gadite men so brave
Crossed the Jordan in the wave

[Outro]
Elzabad ninth among the brave
A name in David's army grave
